redact_API_keys_tokens: redact API keys, tokens, and credentials from log messages or tool output strings
redact_ENV_assignments: redact environment variable assignments like OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-abc123 from text
redact_JSON_fields: redact secret values in JSON fields like "apiKey": "value" from strings
redact_private_keys: redact PEM private key blocks (BEGIN/END RSA PRIVATE KEY) from text
redact_database_connection_strings: redact passwords in database connection strings like postgres://user:pass@host
